messages:
Maya (Design): Quick design check — trying a 'compact' variant for buttons in the new dashboard table row. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/protos/compact-buttons.png
Tom (Frontend): looks tighter, nice. what are the token deltas? :eyes:
Maya (Design): Using spacing tokens: compact reduces row padding from `space-3` -> `space-2` and button height from 40px -> 32px. also switches button variant to `ghost-compact` for secondary actions.
Tom (Frontend): can we keep touch target >= 32px? mobile tap area is the thing. also need consistent baseline for icon-only buttons.
Sophia (Accessibility): 32px min target ok, but keyboard focus outline is getting lost at that height in dense rows. recommend 2px high-contrast focus ring (WCAG perceivable).
Maya (Design): noted. proposal: add `button--compact` class that increases left/right hit padding with negative visual padding so visual compactness preserved but touch target maintained.
Liam (Product): Minor copy nit: toasts after bulk actions read "X changes saved" — propose "Changes queued" when operation is async with background processing.
Tom (Frontend): +1 for copying change. For the modal confirm size — current modal uses `max-width: 680px` which feels too wide in compact layout. Suggest 560px. Thoughts?
Maya (Design): 560px feels better for confirm dialogs. Will update specs. Also moving modal footer buttons to right-aligned in compact mode.
Sophia (Accessibility): for tables — keyboard row focus should also show row-level highlight (not just the cell). Also ensure `role=row` and `aria-selected` toggles for selection.
Tom (Frontend): re tokens: patch in storybook with `--space-2: 8px`, `--space-3: 12px`. I'll add a knob to toggle compact mode so QA can test.
design-bot: Story "components/button/compact" deployed to staging — https://staging.storybook.redwood.dev/?path=/story/components-button-compact :robot_face:
Maya (Design): Ty! Can folks review staging by EOD? I'll attach before/after exports in Figma.
Liam (Product): I'll sanity-check the toast copy + canary metrics for error rates.
Sophia (Accessibility): I'll run the a11y audit flow and ping if anything else comes up. :white_check_mark:
Tom (Frontend): I'll open a PR with CSS and accessibility updates. ping me @Maya if you want the `ghost-compact` token name changed.
Maya (Design): please keep name semantic — `ghost-compact` works for now. thanks all :sparkles:
